## Codex 重置预测看板 2.3.0

- 日历按月份分开展示，格内信息居中；今天使用蓝色边框和蓝色日期圆圈，支持清除日期假设。
- “假设 X 天”和日历指定时间分别显示为独立横条，两个假设可分别清除，四条横条均可拖动排序。
- 校正历史重复计数：同轮观察与完成合并，回顾和限定套餐修复单独标注，保留原帖及各站时间。
- 顶栏固定，滚动时仍可查看信源状态、刷新和打开设置。

- 新增时区设置，默认北京时间；看板、日历及系统通知随所选时区换算。

## English

- The calendar is grouped by month with centered dates and times. Today has a blue border and date circle; calendar targets can be cleared.
- The assumed X-day cycle and calendar target have separate pace bars. Clear either assumption and drag to reorder all four bars.
- Corrected duplicate history counts by merging observations with the same reset completion. Recaps and plan-specific fixes are listed separately, with original posts and source times retained.
- The title bar stays visible while scrolling, keeping source status, refresh and Settings within reach.
- Adds time zone settings, defaulting to Beijing time. Dashboard dates, the calendar and Windows notifications use the selected zone.
